services.name: Septic tank service coordination
services.description: Coordinate the work at the accessible tank identified in the agreed site record. Additional tanks, concealed defects and access alterations are excluded unless added to a revised quotation.

services.name: Drainage repairs
services.description: Repair the drainage points listed in the sample scope. Scope limits, access arrangements and reinstatement follow the agreed site notes. No unlisted fixtures or concealed replacements are included.

services.name: Ceiling repair and restoration
services.description: Restore the agreed ceiling areas using the materials confirmed for this example. The scope does not include structural changes or repairs outside the identified areas.

services.name: Pest treatment coordination
services.description: Coordinate treatment of the assessed areas through the assigned specialist. Specific treatment methods, return visits and any warranty must be confirmed separately before inclusion.
